## 🛡️ Contributor Checklist
Before submitting, please ensure your contribution adheres to the project standards:
- [ ] **Deterministic Tests**: `npm test` passes 100% locally with zero failures.
- [ ] **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: No third-party npm packages added to `dependencies` (Node.js built-ins only).
- [ ] **Bilingual Documentation**: If updating `README.md`, the equivalent changes are reflected in `README.en.md`.
- [ ] **Local Privacy**: No tracking, telemetry, or external network calls introduced.
- [ ] **No Secrets**: No API keys, credentials, or private workspace paths committed.
- [ ] **Code of Conduct**: I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
